title: Simultaneous representative formula for the prescribed system tensor shifts
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E/Q_ell and a scheme W. On the entire coefficient sequence site use the actual total tensor T, the derived system tensor, and the prescribed first/second slot comparisons [def-pur-integral-operation-shift-data]. For every pair of K-flat complexes P,Q and integers a,b, P[a] and Q[b] are K-flat. There is a chain isomorphism T(P[a],Q[b]) ≅ T(P,Q)[a+b] whose coefficient on the shifted (i,j) generator is (-1)^(bi). Its localization, composed with the actual K-flat comparison and the output localization shift, is exactly the simultaneous prescribed derived shift obtained by extracting the second slot, then the first slot, then identifying [a][b] with [a+b]. This holds on every K-flat pair, without requiring flat terms; the chain isomorphism lives on the whole sequence site and therefore retains all quotient transitions.

proof.text: Apply systemLeft_normalized to P,Q,a, obtaining shifted K-flatness, a first-slot chain isomorphism beta, its unsigned generator formula and its derived square. Apply systemRight_normalized to P[a],Q,b, obtaining shifted K-flatness of Q, a second-slot chain isomorphism gamma, its signed formula and its derived square. Compose gamma, the b-shift of beta, and the inverse shift-addition isomorphism. Naturality of degree reindexing and composition of the degree equality transports combine the formulas with coefficient (-1)^(bi). Naturality of the prescribed right-slot comparison factors the simultaneous derived input shift into the two normalized squares. Cancel the middle K-flat comparison. Naturality and the addition axiom of the localization shift combine these squares into the required equality. These properties already apply to every K-flat pair, so no flat-term replacement is needed.

theorem systemTensorShiftRepresentativeModels (W : Scheme.{u}) :
    let t := fun a b : ℤ ↦
      isoWhiskerLeft (tensorShiftFirst (System l E W) a) ((tensorShifts l E).systemRight W b) ≪≫
        isoWhiskerRight ((tensorShifts l E).systemLeft W a) (shiftFunctor (System l E W) b) ≪≫
        isoWhiskerLeft (calculus l E W).systemClosed.tensor
          (shiftFunctorAdd (System l E W) a b).symm
    ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E W) ℤ)
        (hP : systemKFlat l E W P) (hQ : systemKFlat l E W Q) (a b : ℤ),
        ∃ (hPa : systemKFlat l E W (P⟦a⟧)) (hQb : systemKFlat l E W (Q⟦b⟧))
          (α : (systemTotalTensor l E W).obj (P⟦a⟧, Q⟦b⟧) ≅
            ((systemTotalTensor l E W).obj (P, Q))⟦a + b⟧),
          (∀ (i j : ℤ) (U : (ℕ × W.ProEt)ᵒᵖ)
        (x : (P.X (i + a)).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X (j + b)).val.obj U),
        ((α.hom.f (i + j)).val.app U)
          (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u + 1, u}
            (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology W))
            (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W)
            (P⟦a⟧) (Q⟦b⟧) i j (i + j) rfl U x y) =
        ((CochainComplex.shiftFunctorObjXIso ((systemTotalTensor l E W).obj (P, Q))
          (a + b) (i + j) ((i + a) + (j + b)) (by omega)).inv.val.app U)
          ((b * i).negOnePow • coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u + 1, u}
            (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology W))
            (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W)
            P Q (i + a) (j + b) ((i + a) + (j + b)) rfl U x y)) ∧
          (calculus l E W).systemClosed.tensor.map
              (Prod.mkHom ((DerivedCategory.Q.commShiftIso a).hom.app P)
                ((DerivedCategory.Q.commShiftIso b).hom.app Q)) ≫
              (t a b).hom.app
                (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) =
            ((calculus l E W).systemTensorModel.iso
              (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology W))
              (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W) (calculus l E W).systemClosed
              (P⟦a⟧) (Q⟦b⟧) hPa hQb).inv ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map α.hom ≫
            (DerivedCategory.Q.commShiftIso (a + b)).hom.app
              ((systemTotalTensor l E W).obj (P, Q)) ≫
            (shiftFunctor (System l E W) (a + b)).map
              (((calculus l E W).systemTensorModel.iso
                (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology W))
                (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W) (calculus l E W).systemClosed
                P Q hP hQ).hom)
